data.gender_notes: Nazeehah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: giver of good advice, kind, helpful
data.long_meaning: The one who gives good advice, kind, and helpful. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'nazahaha' which means 'to advise, to caution, to suggest, to admonish'. This name signifies a person who is always ready to help and guide others, and is known for her kindness and generosity. The name Nazeehah carries the meaning “giver of good advice, kind, helpful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nazeehah usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of good advice, kind, helpful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nazeehah represents the inner wisdom and guidance that comes from a connection to the divine. It symbolizes the ability to listen to the voice of intuition and to offer sound advice to others based on this inner knowledge. This name is a reminder to be kind, compassionate, and helpful in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Nazeehah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “giver of good advice, kind, helpful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazeehah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نَزِيحَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: تعود تسمية نَزِيحَة إلى الأصل اللغوي النَزِيح-ة، الذي يشتق من الجذر نَزَا-هَا، ويحمل معاني الخير والمبادرة، والتقدُّم في الفعل، والخير والفضيلة، ويعتبر اسم نَزِيحَة مصدراً للفعل النَزِيح، وتُعتبر نَزِيحَة إحدى الأسماء النبوية، حيث قيل أنّ النبي محمد ﷺ كان يُدعى نَزِيحَة، ويعتبر هذا الاسم من أسماء الصالحين، وقد شاع استخدام هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي، ويعتبر نَزِيحَة اسماً مقدساً في الثقافة الإسلامية، ويعكس قيم الخير والمبادرة والخير في الإسلام

in_english.name: Nazeehah
in_english.meaning: Pious and benevolent, doing good and assisting in it
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nazeehah originates from the Arabic root Naz-aha, which means pious and benevolent, doing good and assisting in it. In Islamic tradition, the name Nazeehah is considered one of the names of the righteous, and it is said to have been given to the Prophet Muhammad. The name Nazeehah is also mentioned in the Quran, where it is described as a name that is dear to Allah. In Islamic culture, the name Nazeehah is considered a symbol of piety and benevolence, and it is often given to girls born into Muslim families. The name Nazeehah is also associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, generosity, and compassion. In modern times, the name Nazeehah has become popular among Muslim parents who want to give their child a name that reflects their Islamic values and traditions
